records.title: UEFI 2.11 §7.4.6 Boot Services: ExitBootServices / GetMemoryMap
supports: wrong MapKey -> EFI_INVALID_PARAMETER; GetMemoryMap+ExitBootServices must be called again
after first EBS call, only Memory Allocation Services may be called among boot services
GetMemoryMap EFI_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL returns needed size; allocating the buffer may enlarge the map

Table 7.6 'Memory Type Usage after ExitBootServices()': EfiBootServicesCode/Data = 'Memory available for general use'; EfiRuntimeServices*/EfiACPIMemoryNVS preserved; EfiACPIReclaimMemory preserved until ACPI is enabled; EfiReservedMemoryType 'Not usable'; EfiMemoryMappedIO not used by the OS (verified 2026-10-18 from the HTML text)
